items.title: Flatness of a quasi-coherent module under a flat morphism of algebraic spaces

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for morphisms f : X -> Y and g : Y -> Z of algebraic spaces over S, a quasi-coherent G on Y and a point x of |X| with image y, flatness of f at x makes flatness of G over Z at y equivalent to flatness of f^*G over Z at x; in particular, for f surjective and flat the two global flatness statements are equivalent (source lines 6505-6519). The proof reduces the claim to algebra by fixing a geometric point of X over x, applying the two flatness-at-a-point characterisations and the description of the stalk of the pullback, so that the statement becomes one about the chain of local ring maps O_Z -> O_Y -> O_X and the module G_y, which is a standard flatness descent statement.
